fullPassage: Pre-Consumer Waste is "waste" that is generated by the industrial processes used to make the products or packaging that we buy as consumers. This is manufacturing "waste" and is typically very clean, of consistent quality and comprises only a single material. Examples are: offcuts from aluminium cans; cardboard boxes or clothing; trimmings from prepreparing vegetables; or wood or textile offcuts from making furniture. Such "waste" was in the past often sent for disposal, but increasingly producers are recycling their internal "waste" to save money by turning unwanted trimmings or offcuts back into useable raw materials. As a result, the materials that end up in our finished products represent a surprisingly small amount of what we originally took from the earth. To send such materials for disposal is not only poor financial practice by the producer, from an environmental perspective it is criminal. These are good-quality, clean and easily collectable materials that just happen to be in the wrong form: so recycle or recover them!

det.korean: 원하지 않는 자투리나 절삭물을 다시 사용 가능한 원재료(useable raw materials)로 바꾸어 돈을 절약한다

❌ ① finished consumer goods — 완성된 소비재. 재활용의 결과물이 아닌 최종 제품을 가리키므로 맥락에 부적합
✅ ② useable raw materials — 사용 가능한 원재료. 생산자가 자투리를 원재료로 되돌려 비용을 절감한다는 본문 흐름에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ disposable packaging items — 일회용 포장재. 재활용 목적과 정반대 방향
❌ ④ industrial waste products — 산업 폐기물. 폐기물을 다시 폐기물로 바꾼다는 것은 논리적 모순
det.tip: turning unwanted trimmings or offcuts back into ___: '되돌린다(back into)'는 원래 형태인 원재료(raw materials)를 가리킨다

questions.passage: Pre-Consumer Waste is "waste" that is generated by the industrial processes used to make the products or packaging that we buy as consumers. This is manufacturing "waste" and is typically very clean, of consistent quality and comprises only a single material. Examples are: offcuts from aluminium cans; cardboard boxes or clothing; trimmings from prepreparing vegetables; or wood or textile offcuts from making furniture. Such "waste" was in the past often sent for disposal, but increasingly producers are recycling their internal "waste" to save money by turning unwanted trimmings or offcuts back into useable raw materials. As a result, the materials that end up in our finished products represent a surprisingly small amount of what we originally took from the earth. To send such materials for disposal is not only poor financial practice by the producer, from an environmental perspective it is criminal. These are good-quality, clean and easily collectable materials that just happen to be in the wrong form: so recycle or recover them!
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: in the wrong form이지만 양질의 가치 있는 재료 → 재활용 촉구가 핵심
det.analysis:
❌ ① 제조업의 숨겨진 비용 ~ — 숨겨진 비용이 주제가 아님
✅ ② 잘못된 형태, 올바른 가치: 소비자 이전 폐기물의 재활용 — 'in the wrong form' + 양질의 가치 있는 재료라는 핵심 메시지를 정확히 반영 ←정답
❌ ③ 소비자와 생산자: 폐기물 책임의 공유 ~ — 책임 공유를 논하지 않음
❌ ④ 깨끗한 폐기물의 역설 ~ — 현재는 increasingly recycling이므로 '여전히 버리는가'와 맞지 않음
